title: Predict type
description:
Instead of computing all the outputs for `predict()`, use `type` option for "class", "prob", or "score". 

Note: The RDA equivalence tests for LDA and QDA are somewhat off. Perhaps @ramhiser could take a look. 

Also changed examples to use the Palmer penguin data [instead of the iris data](https://armchairecology.blog/iris-dataset/).

title: clean up prediction code
description:
- Simplified documentation
- Ensure that with missing values, the predicted results have `nrow(newdata)` results. 
- With formula methods, `predict()` now puts `newdata` in the same format. 
- A zero-variance filter for when predictors have a single unique value within each class.

title: Doc updates
description: Simplified the roxygen markup and fixed links. Also updated GHA to use `pak`.
